They hold the silence of centuries, the weight of forgotten stories, and the traces of lives that have long since disappeared. Inspired by the mysterious atmosphere of Rosslyn Chapel, *The Last Light* tells an original Mucheng legend about a solitary wanderer who enters a world of ancient stones, hidden secrets and fading voices. He walks through shadows, searching for something that may never have been meant to be found. Beneath the silence, however, a small flame refuses to die — a final light that carries the memory of everything that once was. Driven by a powerful male solo voice, orchestral strings, the solemn resonance of the church organ and the haunting sound of the oboe, the aria unfolds as a journey from darkness towards remembrance. It is not a story about solving a mystery. It is about preserving what matters, even when everything else fades away. **“Some things are not meant to be found. They are meant to be remembered.”** *ROSSLYN CHAPEL — THE LAST LIGHT* An original orchestral aria from the world of Mucheng. Written, composed and produced by Kay Uwe Rott.

Driven by a powerful male solo voice, orchestral strings, the solemn resonance of the church organ and the haunting sound of the oboe, the aria unfolds as a journey from darkness towards remembrance.

lyrics:
Lyrics by Kay Uwe Rott ROSSYLN CHAPEL — THE LAST LIGHT A Mucheng Legend Orchestral Aria · Male Solo Voice I walked where ancient shadows sleep, Where silent stones their secrets keep. Beneath the arches, cold and grey, I heard a voice from yesterday. No book was written, none was told, No hand could touch the things they hold. Yet every stone beneath my feet Remembered hearts that once did beat. And somewhere underneath the ground, Beyond the walls, beyond all sound, A little flame refused to die, A final star beneath the sky. Let the last light shine forever, Through the darkness, through the years. What was lost is lost no longer, What remains is stronger than our fears. I will carry what was broken, I will guard what time has torn. For a light that lives in silence Can be waiting to be born. I saw the names no one remembers, I felt the weight of vanished days. The walls were filled with old November, With words that never found their way. And then I understood the meaning Of all the carvings in the stone. They were not made to praise the living, But to remind us we're not alone. For every promise left behind, For every soul that lost its way, There is a place beyond the shadows Where the light still knows your name. Let the last light shine forever, Through the darkness, through the years. What was lost is lost no longer, What remains is stronger than our fears. I will carry what was broken, I will guard what time has torn. For a light that lives in silence Can be waiting to be born. And if one day my voice should vanish, And if my footsteps disappear, Let these stones remember something: I was here. I was here. I am the keeper of the last light, I am the witness of the years. Not for glory, not for heaven, But for all that disappears. Let the ancient stones remember, Let the silent heavens know: Even when the world falls silent, There is still a light below. description:
此曲邀請金曲歌手「雅維·茉芮 Yaway‧Mawring」跨刀獻聲，客語與原住民語的激盪，短短幾句歌詞，在高冷、淒美的樂聲中，龔德用客語悠悠唱起、描繪著冷冷的心渴望被看見，雅維·茉芮則在中段加入了原住民語，描述「就算你帶著笑我卻無法看透你，你的思想壞了，也許是想的太多了，停止吧......」就像在不透光的懸崖邊，回應著冷冷的心的哭喊。 這首歌從群體中的理所當然，到個體上的心靈變化，一句句、一層層堆疊到尾句的「求救訊號」。龔德曾經擔任特教老師、白場樂手，聽過不少心碎的故事，一直都很想跟對方說：我們看見你了，即便再渺小、再孤獨的一個人，冷冷的心終會被看見。〈冷冷〉藉由描繪迷失的過程，欲撫慰無處安放的靈魂，期許自己和社會更加溫暖真誠，讓迷路的心，不再覺得冷。 作詞 Lyricist：龔德 Kung Ta／Yaway Mawring 作曲 Composer：龔德 Kung Ta 製作人Producer：林易祺 LNiCH@給樂音樂 製作助理Production Assistant：郭冠鑫 Attis 編曲Arrangement：龔德 Kung Ta／林易祺 LNiCH@給樂音樂 木吉他Acoustic Guitar：龔德 Kung Ta 和聲Backing Vocal：龔德Kung Ta／Yaway Mawring 手碟Hand Pan：Damiano Della Torre 打擊Percussion：Santiago 低音管／雙簧管／中音笛Bassoon／Oboe／Alto Flute：Brandon Wilkins 人聲錄音師Vocals Recording Engineers：郭冠鑫 Attis／張閔翔 Min-Hsiang Chang 木吉他錄音師Acoustic Guitar Recording Engineers：張閔翔 Min-Hsiang Chang 錄音室 Recording Studio：給樂錄音室 Gather Music Studio 混音師 Mixing Engineer：張閔翔 Min-Hsiang Chang／林易祺 LNiCH@給樂音樂 混音錄音室 Mixing Studio：給樂錄音室 Gather Music Studio 母帶後期處理工程師 Mastering Engineer：Felix Davis 母帶後期錄音室 Mastering Studio：Metropolis Studio
